systems.system: Agenda de Transição Digital da Administração Pública 2027 (Agenda GOVERNO.AO 27)
systems.owner: Government of Angola; projects identified by the Instituto de Modernização Administrativa (IMA) with the ICT services of the ministries
systems.tiers: public administration; approved by Presidential Decree 178/24 of 31 July 2024 after the Council of Ministers of 26 June 2024; six strategic objectives, seven axes (including governance and reporting, and financing and sustainability) and 218 projects across 27 government bodies, each with targets, timetables and performance indicators
national; approved by Presidential Decree 225/23 of 30 November 2023; its State Reform domain carries guidelines on modernising and digitalising public administration

systems.country_label: Estratégia de Longo Prazo para Angola até 2050
systems.tiers: named as the long-term strategy with which the Agenda is aligned; its digital content is not described

systems.system: Roteiro para a Reforma do Estado
systems.country_label: Roteiro para a Reforma do Estado
systems.tiers: named as an action with which the Agenda is aligned; its content is not described

note: The decree approves a strategy for digitalising public administration only, so it is class government and gives no national-class fact; the Digital Economy for Africa diagnostic and the Digital Government Readiness Assessment are cited as tools, not as a national strategy.
